approvalScope: Caption treatment approved on mall infection EP1 v2; independent of scene and voice approval
defaultFor: New Thai-narrated JK Animation Studio videos unless the user requests another caption treatment or no captions

english.placement: smaller secondary line directly below Thai
english.content: concise faithful translation; not a second voice track

highlight.selection: one meaningful word or short phrase per cue, not the whole line
highlight.semantics: amber key information; coral threats/prohibitions; cyan clues or contrasting options

layout.placement: overlay on full-frame scene; adapt around faces, signs and platform UI without reserving a band

timing: use real narration; estimates are phrase timing, not word-level karaoke
